COMPLETE SYSTEM

the vehicle.

Sonar and a single-function gripper are optional items purchased separately. The brochure lists 2–5 hours of R-20Li battery operation; actual runtime depends on load, current and installed equipment. Battery shipment follows the dangerous-goods rules that apply to the supplied battery.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

QUESTIONS

Before you specify the R-20 / R-20Li.

Should I choose the R-20 or the R-20Li?

The two share the same vehicle figures. The R-20 runs on an external tethered supply for longer missions; the R-20Li carries its own lithium battery for sites where power access is difficult and missions are short.

Can it inspect pipes or culverts?

The manufacturer describes use in drainage culverts and municipal networks. Check the smallest opening, bends, tether drag and recovery route against the fully equipped vehicle before planning an internal pipe inspection.

What affects R-20Li runtime?

Current, manoeuvring, lighting, water temperature and added equipment all draw on the battery. Treat the 2–5 hour brochure range as a planning band and confirm runtime for your configuration.
